description: This file defines the 'Compiler' class for the SCSSPHP project, responsible for parsing, compiling, and transforming SCSS source code into CSS. It includes methods for compiling strings and files, handling @rules like @media and @at-root, managing import paths, and processing selectors and extends. The class also manages environment stacks, caching, source maps, and formatting options, forming the core of the SCSS compilation process.

classes.name: Compiler
classes.description: The main class responsible for compiling SCSS code into CSS, managing parsing, environment, import caching, source maps, formatting, and extension handling.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Deprecated method to compile SCSS string into CSS. Internally calls compileString.

methods.name: compileFile
methods.description: Compiles a SCSS file at given path into CSS, reading file content and calling compileString.

methods.name: compileString
methods.description: Core method that compiles SCSS source code (string) into CSS, with caching, environment setup, parsing, and formatting.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets an alternative logger for the compiler, replacing the default error stream.

methods.name: setErrorOuput
methods.description: Deprecated: sets an error output stream; replaced by setLogger.

methods.name: collapseSelectorsAsList

methods.name: flattenSelectorSingle

methods.name: popCallStack

methods.name: compileImport
